name: Production-Grade To-Do List Application
description: A high-performance, accessible, and feature-rich to-do list application built with a modern stack including React, TypeScript, and Express. Includes full CRUD capabilities, persistence, and a polished UI.

details: Initialize npm project with 'npm init -y'
Install core frontend dependencies: react, react-dom
Install backend dependencies: express, cors, zod, dotenv
Install dev tools: vite, typescript, vitest, jsdom, @types/react, @types/react-dom, @types/express
Create .env file for environment variables like PORT and API_URL
Create a root tsconfig.json with support for React and Node
Create vite.config.ts for frontend bundling and proxying API requests
Scaffold src/client and src/server directory structure
Create index.html in the root with a mount point for the React app
Set up Vitest configuration for unit and integration testing
Create src/server/app.ts to configure Express middleware (CORS, JSON parsing)
Implement a central error handling middleware in src/server/middleware/error.ts
Define the Todo interface and Zod schema in src/shared/types.ts
Create src/server/routes/todoRoutes.ts for routing logic
Implement a request logging middleware for better observability in src/server/middleware/logger.ts
tests: Router should correctly map defined paths to their respective handlers
Invalid routes should return 404 Not Found
Error handler should return formatted JSON for exceptions
CORS middleware should be present in the application stack

details: Implement an in-memory Todo storage class in src/server/repository/todoRepository.ts
Add methods for Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations in the repository
Implement data seeding for initial development state
Ensure the repository handles 'not found' cases by throwing specific errors
Add filtering logic to the repository for completed/active states
tests: Repository should correctly store and retrieve a todo item
Repository should update todo status correctly in memory
Repository should delete a todo and reflect change in the list
Repository should throw error when accessing a non-existent todo ID

details: Create src/server/controllers/todoController.ts to handle request-response logic
Implement GET /api/todos to fetch all todos with optional filtering
Implement POST /api/todos with Zod validation for the request body
Implement PATCH /api/todos/:id for partial updates (toggle status, edit text)
Implement DELETE /api/todos/:id to remove a todo item
tests: POST /api/todos should return 201 and the created todo object
POST /api/todos should return 400 for invalid input schema
GET /api/todos should return an array of todos with 200 OK
PATCH /api/todos/:id should return the updated todo object
DELETE /api/todos/:id should return 204 No Content
All CRUD operations should be functional and return appropriate status codes
API should enforce data integrity via Zod schema validation

tasks.description: React Entry Point and Core Layout
details: Create src/client/main.tsx to bootstrap the React application
Implement src/client/App.tsx with a responsive layout structure
Create a central layout component in src/client/components/Layout.tsx
Set up global CSS variables for colors, spacing, and typography in src/client/index.css
Implement a Header component for the application title and branding
tests: App component should render without crashing
Main layout elements (header, main container) should be present in the DOM
CSS variables should be correctly applied to the root element

details: Create src/client/services/api.ts for interacting with the backend using Fetch API
Implement custom React hooks (e.g., useTodos) for data fetching and mutations
Set up a TodoContext in src/client/context/TodoContext.tsx for global state management
Implement optimistic UI updates for better perceived performance
Add error handling and loading states within the context provider
tests: API service should correctly call fetch with proper headers and JSON body
TodoContext should provide todos state to consumer components
Optimistic updates should immediately reflect in state before API resolution
Loading state should be active during initial data fetch
Frontend should correctly communicate with the backend API via the service layer
State changes in TodoContext should trigger re-renders in consumer components

details: Create src/client/components/TodoList.tsx to render the collection of todos
Implement src/client/components/TodoItem.tsx for individual todo display
Add interactive checkboxes for completion and buttons for deletion
Implement inline editing functionality for todo text
Ensure accessible labels and ARIA roles for all interactive elements
tests: TodoList should render the correct number of items from state
Clicking completion checkbox should trigger the toggle action in state
Clicking delete button should trigger the remove action in state
TodoItem should enter edit mode on double-click or edit button click

tasks.description: Add Todo Form and List Filtering
details: Create src/client/components/AddTodoForm.tsx with a controlled input and submit button
Implement form validation to prevent empty or whitespace-only todo items
Create src/client/components/TodoFilters.tsx for 'All', 'Active', and 'Completed' views
Add a 'Clear Completed' button to batch-remove finished tasks
Display an empty state message when no todos match the current filter
tests: Submitting the form with valid text should create a new todo item
Submitting an empty form should prevent action and show a validation error
Changing filters should update the visible list of todos based on status
Empty state should be visible when the filtered list length is zero
User should be able to perform all CRUD operations via the UI
Filtering and clearing completed tasks should work as expected

details: Implement a modern, clean design using Vanilla CSS Flexbox and CSS Grid
Add CSS transitions for adding/removing items (fade-in, slide-out effects)
Ensure full responsiveness across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports
Implement interactive hover, active, and focus states for all buttons and inputs
Add a dark mode theme toggle using CSS custom properties and media queries
tests: Layout should adjust correctly on mobile screen widths (breakdown of columns)
Interactive elements should have visible focus indicators for keyboard navigation
Animations should play when items are added or removed from the list
Color contrast should meet WCAG AA standards

details: Audit application for accessibility (a11y) compliance using browser tools
Implement React.memo where necessary to prevent unnecessary list re-renders
Run final integration tests across the integrated frontend and backend
Perform a production build and verify asset optimization in the dist/ folder
Add project documentation (README.md) for setup and architecture details
tests: Application should achieve high scores in accessibility audits
Production build should successfully generate optimized JS and CSS bundles
All functional tests should pass in the production-like local environment
Final application should be responsive, accessible, and free of console errors
Build process should be streamlined and well-documented
